## Custom GUI Mod v1.1.1

This release introduces the first major GUI overhaul focused on the rune and element system.

### Highlights

- Reworked the main custom GUI layout.
- Added a fixed 26-slot rune grid for the first element.
- Introduced rune terminology and element-based navigation.
- Added separate visual states for empty and obtained rune slots.
- Added temporary Minecraft item icons for obtained runes.
- Added rune type badges: Click, Earth, Boost, Resource and Click / Earth.
- Added visual rank framing for Normal, Silver and Gold rune states.
- Added an element selector above the rune inventory.
- Added the right-side navigation panel for future GUI sections.
- Added compact player statistics and resources panels.
- Improved GUI scaling for different window sizes.
- Fixed player model rendering so the skin keeps its correct colors.
- Added regression tests for the fixed rune catalog and rune inventory structure.

### Current limitations

- The 26-purchase limit is temporary and will be reworked in later versions.
- Rune effects and real rank progression are not implemented yet.
- Duplicate rune rewards are not implemented yet.
- Minecraft item icons are temporary placeholders.
- Some legacy deck/card terminology remains for compatibility.

### Screenshots

The README contains updated screenshots showing the full rune collection, empty collection, purchase progression and compact GUI scaling.

### Download

Use the attached `customguimod-1.1.1.jar`.
